info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Loan By Param2-spec
info.description: The Manage Loan Repayment Schedules API allows for the deletion of specific repayment schedule entries associated with a loan. By targeting a loan through its unique identifier, this endpoint facilitates the removal of a repayment schedule identified by a secondary parameter. This functionality is critical for financial institutions and loan service providers managing loan portfolios. Typical consumers of this API include loan processing systems, financial managers, and customer service applications that require accurate repayment schedule management.

delete.summary: Delete a repayment schedule for a specific loan.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a repayment schedule associated with a particular loan. Ensure that you verify the loan and schedule identifiers before performing this action to maintain data integrity.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the deletion of a specific repayment schedule associated with the loan identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure that the repayment schedule identified by RES-100045 exists before proceeding with the deletion request.

DeleteLoanByParam2Request.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting a repayment schedule operation associated with a specific loan.

DeleteLoanByParam2Response_204.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation on repayment schedules of a specific loan.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: An identifier to trace the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

ResponseMetadata.description: Metadata providing additional context about the response.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: Identifier for the endpoint that processed the request. This value helps in tracking the specific API endpoint that was called.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name or identifier of the application that was responsible for processing the request. This header is useful for monitoring application-specific performance and behavior.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication scheme that uses JWT (JSON Web Token) as a bearer token. This type of authentication is often used in APIs to secure endpoints by requiring a valid JWT token to be provided in the Authorization header of the request.
